name: Incompressible Aerodynamics: Airfoils and Wings
summary: Potential-flow theory for low-speed airfoils and finite wings: how lift arises, what sets induced drag and how wings are shaped.

topics.name: Elementary flows: uniform flow, source, sink, doublet, vortex
Flow over a cylinder, d'Alembert's paradox and the Kutta-Joukowski theorem
Airfoil nomenclature and NACA airfoil families
The Kutta condition and Kelvin's circulation theorem
Thin airfoil theory: symmetric and cambered airfoils
Real airfoil behaviour: stall types and viscous effects
Finite wings: downwash, wingtip vortices and induced drag
Biot-Savart law and Helmholtz vortex theorems
Prandtl lifting-line theory and elliptic lift distribution
Effect of aspect ratio, taper and twist
Swept wings and delta wings at low speed
